### Analytics {slug: cold-email-agent/campaigns/managing-campaigns/analytics}
Get here: In the left sidebar, click "Cold Email Agent", then open a campaign. "Analytics" is the default view.
- "Leads Contacted": unique people with at least one email, shown against leads uploaded, never above it. At 100% the campaign keeps sending follow-ups, then moves to Completed.
- "Replies": count and reply rate. The "Include auto replies" toggle is on by default (counts out-of-office); off shows manual replies only.
- "Positive Replies": AI-classified genuine interest, rate vs leads contacted. Target is the Healthy PRR from the "Options" tab (podcast default 1%). Out-of-office, not interested and unsubscribes don't count.
- "Booked Calls": count and rate as % of positive replies. Target default 25%, set on "Options". Good positives but few bookings means the problem is the reply-to-booking handoff.
- Trend chart lines: "Contacted" (emails sent per day, including follow-ups, unlike the KPI), "Replied", "Positive". Ranges: Last 7/14/30/90 days, Last year, All time.
- Per-step tables: "Variant" (enable/disable toggle), "Sent", "Replied", "Positive Responses", "Booked Calls", plus a Total row. All per email. Disabling stops future use; history stays. The agent acts only after a variant passes the "Minimum Threshold" of sends.
- Zero replies after 1,000+ sends: check bounce rate on the "Leads" tab (auto-pauses at 5%), inbox health in "Email Accounts" (below 80% is a problem), an inbox showing Error, and send a test to yourself.
- No activity 3+ days: check campaign status, sending schedule on "Options", inbox health, and any "Attention Needed" banner.
- Lower reply rates at Step 2 or 3: adjust follow-up timing and add a new angle.

### AI Agent {slug: cold-email-agent/campaigns/managing-campaigns/ai-agent}
Get here: In the left sidebar, click "Cold Email Agent", open a campaign, then click the "AI Agent" tab.

- Turn on "AI campaign management": defaults in "Settings" > "Cold Email Agent"; one campaign in "Options" tab > "Cold Email Agent" section. Off means insights only. If it says "Coming soon", it can't be changed yet.
- Modes per action: "Run automatically", "Ask first", "Off".
- "Optimize email variants" (recommended Run automatically); "Add more leads" (can spend lead credits), "Start new campaigns", "Pause underperforming campaigns" (only alongside a replacement; recommended Ask first).
- "How quickly should the agent act?": Careful, Balanced (default), Proactive, Custom.
- Timeline cards: Key Finding, Recommended Actions, Pending Actions, Actions Successfully Taken.
- Approvals appear in the campaign banner or modal, or by email ("Review decision"), and expire after 24 hours. Buttons: Approve, Reject, Review later, Continue (lead filters or CSV needed), Top up.
- "Run actions when approvals expire" is off by default; lead-source blockers still need your input.
- Approval is blocked if it would disable every variant. Re-enable variants on the "Sequences" tab.
- CSV uploads use no lead credits but count toward contact capacity.

### Acquisity AI Lead Search {slug: cold-email-agent/campaigns/managing-campaigns/scrape-leads}
Get here: In the left sidebar, click "Cold Email Agent", open the campaign, click "Leads", "Add Leads", "Lead Database", then "Open Lead Scraper". (New campaign: wizard lead source step, "Acquisity Lead Database".)
- "AI Search" fills filters; or set "Job Titles", "Location", "Industries", company keywords, "Employees" manually. Default: 1-50 employees, United States.
- Finds market categories, not exact ICPs; use a CSV for that.
- Preview companies; check 3-5. Keywords are OR logic: remove a keyword or add it to "Excluded Keywords".
- Click "Next": import count (default 500, min 100), then "Confirm".
- 1 credit = 1 verified lead; previews free; CSV uploads free. Final count can be lower (emails verified live). Top up in the dialog, "Settings" > "Billing", or "Settings" > "Cold Email Agent".
- Standalone: owned leads are filtered out. With a connected sending platform, duplicates can still cost credits.
- "Launch campaigns automatically once the setup is complete": on by default; disabled for "Upload Your Own".
- Capacity: Growth 5,000 campaign leads; other plans often 25,000 per provider workspace. Export CSV then delete leads to free room.
- Reuse filters: campaign "Options" tab, bottom (AI Lead Search campaigns only).
- Test with 1,000-1,500 leads; avoid over 5,000 per campaign.

### Connect Your Custom Domain {slug: ai-website-builder/connect-custom-domain}
Get here: open the website in "AI Website Builder", open domain setup, then choose "I already own a domain".
- Enter the domain, copy each DNS record's Type, Name/Host and Value exactly, and add them where DNS is managed (wherever the nameservers point, not always the registrar). Then wait for verification.
- Subdomain: add records in the main domain's DNS. Host is the short name, e.g. "keepersolutions". Remove any old record with the same host.
- Root host is "@" (blank at Porkbun). "www" for www.
- Cloudflare: set "DNS only" if verification fails.
- Not verifying: check where DNS is managed, exact values, old records, and wait up to 24 hours. Then contact support with the domain and screenshots.
- Connected only points the domain; it needs a successful publish.
